width-sm.comment: A raw dimension on purpose. Tier 2 `size` carries control-height and target-min - a dialog width has no semantic ancestor there, and inventing one would put a modal-shaped value in the public layer where every component can reach it. Tier 3 is private and per-component, which is exactly what a dialog width is.

max-height.comment: How much of the viewport a dialog may take before its body starts scrolling. Viewport-relative by nature, so it has no tier 2 ancestor - the same reasoning as the widths.

viewport-max.comment: The full viewport width, from which the padding is subtracted so a dialog never overflows a narrow screen.
